deco.css: .fd-stars{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:12vh;background:radial-gradient(1.4px 1.4px at 12% 32%,rgba(255,246,214,.9),rgba(255,246,214,0) 60%),radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 34% 62%,rgba(226,214,255,.8),rgba(226,214,255,0) 60%),radial-gradient(1.6px 1.6px at 56% 22%,rgba(255,246,214,.85),rgba(255,246,214,0) 60%),radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 74% 54%,rgba(226,214,255,.8),rgba(226,214,255,0) 60%),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 90% 30%,rgba(255,246,214,.8),rgba(255,246,214,0) 60%);opacity:.85;animation:fd-twinkle 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;pointer-events:none}.fd-bridge{position:fixed;bottom:1.6vh;left:50%;width:36vw;height:5vh;margin:0 0 0 -18vw;border-radius:50% 50% 0 0 / 100% 100% 0 0;background:radial-gradient(60% 140% at 50% 100%,rgba(201,166,217,.30),rgba(201,166,217,0) 70%);pointer-events:none}.fd-altair{position:fixed;bottom:3vh;right:5vw;width:2px;height:2px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,246,214,.7);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,246,214,.6);pointer-events:none}@keyframes fd-twinkle{from{opacity:.55}to{opacity:.95}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.fd-stars{animation:none}}
